description: An attributed MATLAB resource-list fork with a guided route from learning materials to useful contributions.

lessons.title: Orient to the upstream catalogue
lessons.summary: Read the scope, category list and upstream contribution link.
lessons.objective: Understand that this fork organizes pointers to independently maintained resources.
lessons.checkpoint: Keep mikecroucher/awesome-MATLAB visible as upstream; preserve the original authors and license.

lessons.objective: Find a resource appropriate to experience level and environment.

lessons.title: Evaluate a toolbox or plotting resource
lessons.summary: Compare the relevant category entry, description and linked project.
lessons.objective: Choose resources by task and declared capabilities rather than badge count.
lessons.checkpoint: Verify the destination and its own license/support requirements before adoption; listed resources were not installed in this audit.

lessons.title: Prepare a focused catalogue contribution
lessons.summary: Follow upstream style and duplicate-check guidance.
lessons.objective: Draft one relevant resource addition with attribution and a concise description.
lessons.checkpoint: One link per proposed PR, alphabetic ordering, sentence-case description and upstream destination; no PR was submitted.
